Package com.irurueta.navigation.inertial

Class GravityOrGravitationTest

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.GravityOrGravitationTest
class GravityOrGravitationTest extends Object
Tests the hashCode() contract defined by GravityOrGravitation and its consistency with the equals(Object) implementations provided by the concrete subclasses ECEFGravity and ECIGravitation.
